title: Integrate sampled power
prompt: Implement solve(payload), where payload["points"] is a list of [time_seconds, power_watts] samples in supplied order. Integrate using the composite trapezoid rule on each actual interval, returning {"energy_joules": value}. Negative power contributes negative energy. Do not sort or assume equal spacing. Return {"error":"too_few_points"} for fewer than two samples, then {"error":"time_order"} if any time fails to be strictly greater than its predecessor. Other inputs are valid finite numbers and pairs. Do not mutate input. Numerical results use absolute and relative tolerance 1e-8.
